args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified the rollback target** — the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0` (the `v2.3.1-rc` entry was staging-only, so it was excluded).
3. **Rolled back** — deployed `v2.3.0` to all production regions; the rollback is now `rolled_out` and verified.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`) for `checkout-api`, paging on-call, describing the health-check failure and the rollback action taken.

transcript.reasoning_content: Let me start by understanding the current state of checkout-api. I need to check service status and deployment history.
